main_measure.name: position-weighted mean next-bar excess return over coin mean daily return
main_measure.threshold: above 0 with t >= 2 to confirm; <= 0 rejects

supporting_check.name: next-bar return, top third minus bottom third of positions on active bars (Welch t)

decided_by: The main measure is positive but the supporting check has the opposite sign, which meets the inconclusive rule.
reading: Active bars are forecast > 0 pooled over all windows, weighted by postRebalance_current_allocation (zero-position active bars get zero weight); the benchmark is the mean next-bar return over all bars of all windows pooled; the weighted-mean t is the ordinary t of w_i*x_i/mean(w); thirds are the lowest and highest floor(n/3) positions.
